about_the_game:
Your closest servant, Aki, has tracked down a fox with a mysterious card...

This card revealed new horizons of BLOOD MAGIC to you, a VAMPIRE. Take on the fights and puzzles of the forest Yokai to obtain all 48 HANAFUDA CARDS, which can give:

  • Unique abilities like hunting companions (egrets), shadow summoning, flora resource extraction, and much more.

  • Play a role in advanced blood alchemy, such as disintegration and transmutation.

  • The right combination of the cards will give you immunity to sunlight.

You have firmly established yourself in the forest to find as many cards as possible...

You’ll have to survive an ENTIRE YEAR in this magical forest, full of animals and surprises from the Yokai. The cycle of DAY and NIGHT will force you to keep track of time, and your HUNGER for blood will grow with each night. At your undead base, you have access to a few powerful opportunities for survival:

  • Crafting and Forging

  • Alchemy

  • Undead Legion

Is this your chance to become the ULTIMATE VAMPIRE among all others who have not ventured so far?

Develop your talents versatilely to succeed in capturing the cards of each month in Hanafuda:

  • BLOOD MAGIC for health, mana, and stamina

  • PARASITE for hunting and dealing damage

  • ALCHEMIST for brewing advanced potions

  • MONARCH for controlling lower vampires and haunted creatures like Aki

content_descriptors.notes: As a vampire, you extract and drink blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad-core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Become a vampire and survive in the open-world mystical forest, battling inhabitants and overcoming challenges to defeat the Sun by unlocking the secret abilities of the Hanafuda deck.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
